title: OTP: OTP with 6 digits (daisyUI)
notes:
OTP (One-Time Password) component for inputting verification codes. It's usually 4 to 6 digits long and is used for two-factor authentication (2FA) or passwordless login.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/otp/+page.md
